findings.title: ITP-purged IDB returns silent blank form (no recovery prompt)
findings.reproduction: Foreman uses iPad daily for 6 days, takes a 7+ day vacation, opens /daily/submit. Safari ITP has purged the masci.draft.* IDB store AND localStorage. No banner, no warning, no telemetry event — just a blank form.
findings.operational_impact: Returning foreman loses crew-memory preload silently. They re-type everything assuming they were a first-time user. Trust is not violated catastrophically (no data LOST since none was in flight) but operational memory regresses without acknowledgement.
findings.remediation: Emit draft.recovery.absent telemetry on mount when IDB is empty AND a recent stale-flag cookie indicates prior usage. Optionally surface a soft banner: 'Welcome back — your saved setup expired. You can submit a new one.'

findings.title: Sibling forms (NewIncident, NewInspection, HrPayrollVariance) do not persist idempotencyKey across reloads
findings.reproduction: Operator submits NewIncident offline. Queue holds payload. Tab reloads before queue flushes. Operator resubmits. Two records created on the server because the idempotency key was a useRef, not persisted to IDB.
findings.confidence: HIGH (NewDailyReport got the iter440 fix; siblings did not)
findings.operational_impact: Duplicate incidents / inspections / payroll variance entries pollute the dataset, especially under bad signal.
findings.remediation: Wire persistIdempotencyKey / loadIdempotencyKey (already exported from lib/resiliency/useFormDraft.js) into each sibling form's submit path. 4 files × ~8 lines each.
findings.telemetry_visibility: draft.write.fail telemetry would surface the queue collision indirectly
findings.regression_coverage: PARTIAL — covered for Daily Report only

findings.title: ViewCAPA, ViewInspection, ViewMeeting still hardcode back-link labels
findings.reproduction: PM opens a CAPA from a Project Dashboard chip. Back says '← CORRECTIVE ACTIONS' regardless of entry context — same issue iter443 just fixed for Incidents.
findings.operational_impact: Operators lose orientation on shared surfaces, same as the field-reported Incident issue.
findings.remediation: Apply useReturnContext() hook to each shared surface (~15 mins per surface · doctrine fully established in RETURN_PATH_GOVERNANCE_STANDARD.md).
findings.owner: next remediation wave · per-trigger or sweep

findings.title: Quota probe runs but never surfaces a warning to operators
findings.reproduction: Operator's iPad approaches the ITP quota limit (~80%). Saves still work, but the next major save (multi-photo daily report) will silently QuotaExceededError. We have quotaProbe.js but no UI surface displays the warning.
findings.operational_impact: Operator gets one big save failure with no preceding warning. Foreman is mid-typing the narrative.
findings.remediation: Wire estimateQuota() call into useFormDraft.js mount; if ratio ≥0.8, surface a small amber chip near the pill: 'Storage 82% full · consider submitting soon.' No modal, no alarm.
findings.telemetry_visibility: quota.warning event already in the allowlist · just needs to fire

findings.title: Restore prompt impressions / accept / discard are emitted to telemetry but no dashboard reads them
findings.reproduction: Foreman discards a draft. draft.restore.action {choice: discard} fires. The Draft Health tile counts discards in the 24h window but the admin sees only the count — not the trajectory or recent operator-level pattern.
findings.operational_impact: Admin can see 'something happened' but cannot triage a specific operator or device without curling /api/draft-telemetry/recent manually.
findings.remediation: Per-device drill-down in the Draft Health tile (already in finish §Next Action Items). Tile renders a small affordance: clicking the 'devices affected' number expands to a list of last-N affected devices with their event timeline.
findings.regression_coverage: Backend feed is tested; the drill-down UI does not exist yet

findings.title: Device-memory adoption is invisible (no telemetry on Use Setup vs Start Blank)
findings.reproduction: Field-trust review §7 explicitly deferred device_memory.* telemetry events. Today, we cannot answer 'what % of operators use the preload?' or 'are foremen tapping Start Blank because they don't trust the preload?'
findings.operational_impact: We cannot tune the confidence-tiered banner without data.
findings.remediation: Add three events to ALLOWED_EVENTS allowlist on the backend: device_memory.applied, device_memory.declined, device_memory.cleared. Emit them from CrewSetupRestorePrompt button handlers. ~30 mins backend + ~30 mins frontend.
findings.owner: Phase TRUST-2 (after current priority plan lands)

findings.title: Spanish localization of iter442 coaching copy not yet propagated
findings.reproduction: Spanish-speaking operator sees 'Loaded from recent reports on this iPad.' in English. Existing platform-wide Spanish strings translate; the iter440-442 additions do not.
findings.operational_impact: Operational discipline gap for the bilingual field crew. Not a data risk; a trust-erosion risk over time.
findings.remediation: Add ~12 strings to the Spanish dictionary in lib/i18n. No code touch beyond the dict update.

findings.title: RedirectWithId (`/incidents/:id` legacy redirect) loses location.state
findings.reproduction: External email link uses /incidents/abc123. The <Navigate replace /> drops location.state. The page renders with derivation-only context — 'Admin Console' regardless of where the email was sent from.
findings.confidence: HIGH (verified during iter443; SafetyIncidents was rerouted to bypass it)
findings.operational_impact: Only affects deep-links and external email links. Not a critical operational path.
findings.remediation: Update RedirectWithId to read window.history.state and pass it through Navigate's state prop. OR retarget remaining callers to the canonical URL.

findings.title: Daily Report iPad viewport not in mobile regression coverage
findings.reproduction: Superintendents and field leaders use iPad (1024x768 portrait). All draft survivability tests run on 'mobile' viewport (iPhone 390x844) only. The iPad surface may have layout-specific draft-flow regressions.
findings.operational_impact: iPad-only regressions would not be caught.
findings.remediation: Add 'ipad' parametrize value to the existing parametrize list on draft-loss tests. ~3 lines of conftest change + 3 tests.

findings.title: Cross-portal token rotation invalidates pre-rotation tokens for multi-login users
findings.reproduction: User with admin + PM + HR multi-login. Refreshes a token in one portal. Other portals' tabs lose session-recovery. iter440 fixed the draft-orphaning consequence; the session friction remains.
findings.confidence: MEDIUM (drafts are safe; UX friction is still there)
findings.operational_impact: User must re-auth in sibling tabs. Annoying but not data-affecting.
findings.remediation: Out of scope for trust audit. Documenting only.

findings.title: Daily Report submit-time commit() discards draft before queue confirms delivery
findings.reproduction: Documented as H7 in ROOT_CAUSE_HYPOTHESIS_MATRIX. Operator submits while offline. enqueueUpload queues the payload. commit() runs immediately, discarding the IDB draft. If the queue later fails to deliver (corruption, server rejection during retry), the draft is gone — only the queue holds the work.
findings.confidence: MEDIUM (theoretical · queue is bulletproof in practice)
findings.operational_impact: Worst case: silent data loss if the queue ever drops a payload between enqueue and confirmed 2xx.
findings.remediation: Hold the draft for 7 days after enqueue. Only delete on confirmed 2xx. Telemetry: draft.commit.deferred / draft.commit.confirmed events.
findings.telemetry_visibility: PARTIAL (queue depth observable; commit failures not)

findings.title: Draft Health tile cannot distinguish 'no failures' from 'no telemetry reaching server'
findings.reproduction: If client-side telemetry batches all fail to POST (network gate, CDN, etc.), the tile shows 'Healthy: 0 failed saves, 0 discards, 0 devices affected.' This is the same shape as a genuinely healthy day.
findings.operational_impact: A telemetry pipeline failure is invisible from the tile.
findings.remediation: Compare recent_events_60s from /api/draft-telemetry/health against a small floor (e.g., >=1 event/60s during business hours). If below the floor, render 'Quiet' instead of 'Healthy' so the admin knows the signal is suspicious.
findings.telemetry_visibility: the gap IS the visibility issue

findings.title: Foremen on public /daily/submit link have no way to recover an orphaned draft if they clear Safari history
findings.reproduction: Foreman submits 80% of report, screen lock, calls supervisor, foreman accidentally taps 'Clear All Site Data' or similar. IDB wiped. Draft gone.
findings.operational_impact: Total work loss for that report.
findings.remediation: Out of scope — operator deliberate clear is the user's choice. Document only.
findings.telemetry_visibility: draft.write.fail or simply absence of subsequent telemetry

findings.title: Severity badge colors approach red-fatigue threshold across the platform
findings.reproduction: Open /admin/incidents on a busy week. Multiple incidents, all with severity badges (red/orange) AND status pills (open/closed in varying colors) AND OSHA Recordable chips. The eye sees a wall of color and stops parsing.
findings.operational_impact: Admin / Safety supervisor scans the list less effectively; critical items lose visual primacy.
findings.remediation: Reserve red for genuinely actionable urgency only. Move 'OSHA Recordable' to a slate-tone chip and rely on severity = fatality/lost-time alone to merit red. Out of audit scope to implement; flag for visual doctrine pass.
findings.regression_coverage: Visual loudness gate already exists at /app/scripts/diff_doctrine_baseline.py — but it tracks delta, not absolute load.

findings.title: No regression test asserts MongoDB _id is excluded from non-telemetry admin/PM endpoints
findings.reproduction: Only /api/draft-telemetry/recent is tested for _id leak (iter442). Any other endpoint that returns documents from MongoDB could regress and start leaking _id without anyone noticing.
findings.operational_impact: MongoDB _id leak is a data hygiene issue and ObjectId is not JSON-serialisable for frontend, so a leak would also produce parser issues.
findings.remediation: Add a contract test that calls a sampling of /api/admin/* and /api/pm/* endpoints (read-only) and asserts no response body contains the substring '"_id":'. ~20-line test.

findings.title: Soft-deleted drafts (archive store) have no operator-visible recovery affordance
findings.reproduction: Foreman taps Discard on the restore prompt. iter440 soft-deletes to archive for 24h. recoverArchivedDraft() is exported but no UI surface calls it.
findings.operational_impact: Mis-tap on Discard is recoverable in principle (24h) but only via developer tools.
findings.remediation: On NewDailyReport mount, if no live draft but an archived one exists in the last 24h, surface a quiet 'Recover a draft you discarded earlier?' affordance. Hidden-by-default · only shown when archive is present.
findings.regression_coverage: draft archive store tested in iter440

findings.title: PM Portal incident chip on Project Dashboard (if it exists) does not pass state.from
findings.reproduction: Per RETURN_PATH_GOVERNANCE_STANDARD §3, the caller should pass state.from = { key: 'pm-project', label: 'Project Safety', path: '/pm/projects/:id/dashboard' }. If this chip is not yet updated, back falls through to derivation = 'PM Portal' instead of 'Project Safety'.
findings.confidence: MEDIUM (not verified during iter443; deferred per low-risk plan)
findings.operational_impact: PM loses one click of orientation on the way back from an incident.
findings.remediation: Confirm the chip exists, wire state.from. ~2 lines.

findings.title: Pre-deploy doctrine gate does not verify draft-telemetry endpoint reachability post-deploy
findings.reproduction: If a future deploy drops the /api/draft-telemetry route (config drift), the platform looks healthy: drafts still save, pill still shows green, restore still works. The visibility surface is silently dead.
findings.operational_impact: Invisible failure of the observability layer that exists specifically to make other failures visible.
findings.remediation: Add a single curl /api/draft-telemetry/health assertion to the post-deploy verification block in pre_deploy_check.sh.
findings.regression_coverage: Backend route is tested; deploy gate is not.

findings.title: Foreman with no portal token: Draft Health tile cannot surface their device-level pattern (anonymous-only filter exists in deviceId but not on the tile)
findings.reproduction: The tile aggregates 24h activity. Public-mode (anonymous-token) events are counted via the 'anonShare' percentage, but the admin cannot filter to see only anon events.
findings.operational_impact: Triage of public-mode foreman issues requires curl with explicit ?tokenKind=anon (not implemented).
findings.remediation: Add ?tokenKind= filter to /api/draft-telemetry/recent and a corresponding chip in the tile. Optional.

findings.title: Lifecycle telemetry (visibilitychange/pagehide) fires but tile does not distinguish 'flush succeeded' from 'flush failed'
findings.reproduction: An iOS backgrounding event triggers a flush. If the flush fails, draft.write.fail with trigger=visibilitychange fires. The Draft Health tile counts all failed saves but does not separate trigger types.
findings.operational_impact: Cannot tell from the tile whether the failure mode is debounce-time (operator typing) or lifecycle-time (operator backgrounding).
findings.remediation: Add a tiny 'last fail trigger' chip to the tile pulling from the most recent draft.write.fail event's meta.trigger.

findings.title: No documented operator-side trust-fail playbook for 'my work disappeared'
findings.reproduction: Foreman calls supervisor: 'my work disappeared.' Today the supervisor has no script. The Draft Health tile is admin-only; the foreman cannot self-diagnose.
findings.operational_impact: Trust erosion via lack of operator-side recourse.
findings.remediation: One-page printable PDF: 'If your daily report seems missing' — three steps (1) check restore prompt, (2) tap Show Device ID button (TF-022), (3) call office with device ID. Doc only; no platform change.

findings.title: No operator-visible 'Show Device ID' affordance
findings.reproduction: Admin uses the Draft Health tile and wants to triage device ID 'd.7e3a4b...'. The operator has no way to read their own device ID without dev tools.
findings.operational_impact: Triage requires the operator to bring the device to an admin or use developer tools.
findings.remediation: Long-press the autosave pill → tiny popover with 'Device: d.7e3a4b...' · copy-to-clipboard. ~30 lines.

findings.title: PRD.md has grown past 25k lines and is no longer practically searchable
findings.reproduction: ls -la /app/memory/PRD.md → > 25k lines. Search via grep works but reading is impractical for new agents joining the work.
findings.operational_impact: Agent context fork onboarding slows; risk of duplicating prior work.
findings.remediation: Split into PRD.md (static) / CHANGELOG.md (append-only) / ROADMAP.md (backlog). Per system prompt § housekeeping rule.
